title: Camshaft Position Error
shortDescription: Camshaft failed to reach the home position.
fullDescription:
Err 1 on Culligan softeners (HE, Aquasential, Gold series) means the valve camshaft did not return to position 1 within the expected time.

Regeneration will not run until the position is recovered.

fixSteps.title: Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Hold REGEN 3 seconds to restart homing.

fixSteps.title: Inspect motor
fixSteps.instruction: Remove cover, listen for motor and check rotation.

whenToCallPro: If motor and switch test good but error persists.

faq.a: Yes, put valve in bypass to supply unsoftened water.

title: Motor Error
fullDescription:
Err 2 indicates the controller sent drive signals to the cam motor but detected no movement or no current draw.

Common after long idle periods in humid basements where motor bearings corrode.

fixSteps.title: Check connector
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug and reseat motor connector on board.

faq.q: How long does the motor last?

title: Regeneration Timeout
shortDescription: Regen cycle did not complete in allotted time.
fullDescription: Err 3 posts when any phase of the regen cycle exceeds its maximum runtime, commonly from blocked drain or injector.

fixSteps.title: Inspect drain
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure drain hose is not kinked, elevated too high, or frozen.

fixSteps.title: Clean injector
fixSteps.instruction: Remove injector cap and rinse nozzle and screen.

whenToCallPro: If drain line must be re-routed.

faq.a: Partial draw may leave salt behind; another regen fixes it.

title: Flow Meter Fault
shortDescription: No flow pulses received during known usage.
fullDescription: Err 4 means the turbine/flow meter is not reporting water use, so demand regen cannot be scheduled.

fixSteps.title: Check cable
fixSteps.instruction: Reseat meter cable into control board.

fixSteps.title: Flush turbine
fixSteps.instruction: Remove and soak turbine in CLR/vinegar.

faq.a: Yes, press REGEN to trigger manually.

title: Salt Low
shortDescription: Salt level sensor reports empty or low.
fullDescription: Err 5 / Low Salt warning alerts that the brine tank salt is below operating level; regen may continue but softness degrades.

fixSteps.title: Break bridge
fixSteps.instruction: Use broom handle to break crusted salt.

faq.a: Culligan pellets or clean pellet salt.

title: Transformer / Power Fault
fullDescription: Err 6 shows when the 24VAC input from the wall transformer is out of range, usually from a failed transformer or bad outlet.

fixSteps.title: Test outlet
fixSteps.instruction: Plug known device into outlet to confirm power.

whenToCallPro: If board is damaged by surge.

title: Valve Position Sensor
shortDescription: Position switch did not trigger at expected step.
fullDescription: Err 7 indicates the optical or mechanical cam position switch did not trigger during regeneration, halting the cycle.

fixSteps.title: Clean sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe optical sensor window with dry cloth.

fixSteps.title: Inspect cam
fixSteps.instruction: Remove cover and inspect camshaft for broken tabs.

whenToCallPro: If cam or valve body cracked.

faq.a: Keep head cover closed to limit dust.

title: Memory Fault
fullDescription: Err 8 indicates corruption in the EEPROM settings memory; the unit will fall back to defaults.

fixSteps.title: Install surge protector
fixSteps.instruction: Plug unit into surge strip to prevent recurrence.

whenToCallPro: If error returns after surge protection.

title: Communication Error (Aquasential Smart)
shortDescription: Wi-Fi module lost contact with controller.
fullDescription: Err 9 on Aquasential Smart HE models means the Wi-Fi module is not communicating with the main board; monitoring stops but softening continues.

fixSteps.title: Reconnect Wi-Fi
fixSteps.instruction: Use Culligan app to reprovision network.

faq.a: No, only remote monitoring is affected.

title: Battery Backup Low
fullDescription: E1 warns that the memory backup source is weak; short power outages may wipe settings.

fixSteps.title: Replace backup cell
fixSteps.instruction: Replace coin cell or capacitor on board.
